title: olfersia longifolia
intro: Olfersia longifolia, commonly known as Java tea, is a medicinal plant species native to Southeast Asia. The plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Olfersia longifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
